newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct brass mill output up 1.5 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct brass mill output up 1.5 pct year/year.

text.p: Japan's brass mill output in October rose by 1.5 percent from the same month a year ago to a seasonally adjusted 101,465 tonnes, the Japan Brass Makers Association said on Tuesday.
It was the first time that output rose from the previous year after dropping for 12 consecutive months.
Revised data for September put production in that month at a seasonally adjusted 98,987 tonnes, off 0.6 percent year-on-year.

September brass mill shipments were up by 0.5 percent year-on-year at 100,432 tonnes, while inventories were off 0.1 percent from the same month a year earlier at 37,581 tonnes. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
